en.headline: Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart opens this weekend at Cultural Centre
en.dek: The free three-day event at Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza A and B features workshops, lion dance, martial arts and traditional music from 6 to 8 November.
body: The Intangible Cultural Heritage Mart 2026 opens on Friday at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, running for three days under the theme Crafts in Connection, Tradition in Continuation.

Organised by the Earthpulse Society as part of the Hong Kong Culture Festival and Muse Fest 2026, the free event is supported by the Intangible Cultural Heritage Funding Scheme of the Leisure and Cultural Services Department. It takes place at Piazza A and B.

Hours are 3pm to 6pm on Friday and noon to 6pm on Saturday and Sunday. Programmes include workshops on bamboo steamer weaving, paper-art night lights and flower buttons, stage performances such as Hung Shing Choi Lee Fat Fist combined with lion dance and drumming, and Chiu Chow music.
Admission is free for all activities. The organisers said the mart treats heritage as a living practice sustained through participation and reinterpretation rather than a fixed tradition.

zh.headline: 非物質文化遺產市集周末在文化中心舉行
zh.dek: 一連三日免費活動於香港文化中心露天廣場A及B區舉行，設有工作坊、舞獅、武術及傳統音樂表演。
body: 非物質文化遺產市集2026周五起在香港文化中心舉行，一連三日，主題為「連藝融通・續寫傳統」。
活動由地脈協會主辦，屬香港文化節及香港博物館節2026一部分，並獲康樂及文化事務署非物質文化遺產資助計劃支持，地點為露天廣場A及B區。
周五開放時間為下午3時至6時，周六及周日為中午12時至下午6時。節目包括竹蒸籠編織、紙藝夜燈及花鈕工作坊，以及鴻勝蔡李佛拳配合舞獅及獅鼓表演、潮州音樂等。
所有活動免費入場。主辦方表示，市集把非遺視為透過參與和重新詮釋而延續的生活文化，而非固定不變的傳統。
